name: Ranger Falconstrike keeps Falcon's Call's 90 second cooldown (#7617)
contract: Falcon's Call 804715 carries Spell.dbc RecoveryTime 90000, a 90 second cooldown, and the issue reports that using Falconstrike resets it so the ability becomes semi-spammable.

The reset comes from Falconstrike Summon 520588: its effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN on Falcon's Call with BasePoints -1 and DieSides 1, so SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue makes the amount 0, which ModifyAscensionCooldown treats as Ascension's reset sentinel and calls RemoveSpellCooldown(804715). Neither 520588 nor Falconstrike promises a cooldown reset in any tooltip, and the in-tree Dream Flowers case already forbids the same sentinel on 561005 and 800251.

A level 60 Ranger equips bow 3036 and learns the 573060 passive that grants Falconstrike. The Ranger casts Falcon's Call to start the authored cooldown, then a Horn of Alacrity cast prepares the rank 8 Falconstrike 806443, whose effect 1 triggers 520587 and then 520588. The summon helper must fire while the cooldown stays near its authored value, so this fails when Falconstrike erases the cooldown.
The cast checks and the bow isolate the cooldown behaviour from damage and resource handling.
